The '''hummer''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|Scarlet]] [[Bird/Legends|Bird]] that could be found on [[Vohai]]. While infiltrating the [[Arkanian Microtechnologies headquarters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] noted one such bird.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines" />
